governance.note: caiso-42 carries the caiso-40/41 lever stack verbatim and changes the HYDRO INPUT: hydro_eia930_monthly replaces the per-plant EIA-923 hydro budget with the measured EIA-930 monthly grid-total hydro budget, closing the accepted caiso-40 exception (the preliminary 2025 EIA-923 vintage had 26/~160 hydro plants reported, 12.3 vs ~21.35 TWh true, and gas backfilled the gap). Active levers, all measured/forward-reproducible: CAMPD unit-level net-load-filtered outage windows (exogenous availability, outage_source=historic), measured F923 per-plant monthly delivered gas + measured monthly hub-spot basis overlay (gas_monthly_actuals, gas_hub_basis_overlay), measured EIA-930 net interchange via the priced import/export node (priced_interchange), the measured 3-yr EIA-930 p95 corridor forward-ATC envelope (caiso_corridor_atc_forward), the measured EIA-930 monthly hydro budget (hydro_eia930_monthly), EIA-860 cogen-flagged BTM CHP host steam held out of the LP, plant-specific CEMS emission rates, the CAMPD/CEMS-measured CC minimum-stable-load (caiso_ra_min_load_frac 0.26, capacity-weighted P5 turn-down) behind the RA must-offer bridge, and the default-on negative renewable offers (PPA/REC keep-running value, a market-design constant). No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to a residual; no unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so model output lands on actuals.
governance.model_miss_note: Every deciding hard fail is a genuine MODEL MISS (not ledgered), with the root cause diagnosed in results/calibration/FINDING-caiso43-curtailment-2026-07-01.md: the model is never LONG midday (spring midday ~1.8 GW gas vs ~6.8 GW real committed, EIA-930), so a $28 PNW-hydro import tranche or ~$41 gas-CC SRMC is always marginal, giving 0 curtailment / 0 negative hours and the C3a/b body overprice (+48.8/+36.9/+47.1% mean; NRMSE 0.32/0.52/0.54), the C1 2024 CC_REGULAR +9.21 TWh wedge, the C2 2025 gas +12.3%, the C5a CO2 fails (+7.3%/+12.7%) and the C4 2025 gas-dispatch corr 0.416. Root cause is the LP-vs-UC startup-cost gap (the LP cycles gas freely through the spring belly); the curtailment/negative-price stack is structurally correct and waiting on longness. Separate thread: the 2023 C3c tail (107h vs 21h) is generated entirely by the calibrated 7,500 MW WECC_import simultaneous cap — the true binding representation lies between the tranche build and the published-MIC arithmetic sum (~16 GW, which collapses the tail to 0h); a reconciled seam limit is the follow-on experiment (rule #12). Successor experiments: caiso-44 (startup bridge), caiso-45 (bridge + export sink), caiso-48 (bridge + export sink + solar-proportional/seasonal decommitment).
